# Courtney — The Salt-Point: Kairos Emergent from Chaos (2019)

## Chicago 18 forms

**Full note:** Susan J. Courtney, “The Salt-Point: Kairos Emergent from Chaos,” *Journal of Jungian Scholarly Studies* 14, no. 1 (2019): 1–12, https://doi.org/10.29173/jjs3s.

**Shortened note:** Courtney, “Salt-Point.”

**Bibliography:** Courtney, Susan J. “The Salt-Point: Kairos Emergent from Chaos.” *Journal of Jungian Scholarly Studies* 14, no. 1 (2019): 1–12. https://doi.org/10.29173/jjs3s.

## Essay use

An open Jungian scholarly discussion that characterises quaternity as a dynamic symbolic vocabulary of wholeness while explicitly refusing to reduce symbolic meaning to a physical mechanism.

**Claim boundary:** Courtney’s contextual synthesis does not establish Jung’s own wording in *Aion*, the senarius, `2+2²=4+2`, sacred-number causality, QL, or a computational/metaphysical conclusion.

<a id="courtney-2019-salt-point-kairos-chaos-q001"></a>
## Passage card — `courtney-2019-salt-point-kairos-chaos-q001` — Quaternity as a dynamic symbolic vocabulary
^courtney-2019-salt-point-kairos-chaos-q001

> “The circle, square, and point are not static figures in symbology but natural dynamisms of the psyche. The square squares away the personality by reconciling conflict in the numinous, unifying force of the quaternity, which drives and illuminates the process of individuation (Jacobi, 1959, p. 166). The quaternity symbolized a self-organizing principle of wholeness in ancient, medieval, and Renaissance philosophies (Jung, 1958b, pp. 37, 37n), just as Aion was ‘an image of totality’ (Edinger, 1996, p. 16).”

- **Locator:** PDF p. 3/12, “The Square, Quaternity, and Aion.”
- **Status:** quotation-ready.
- **Verification:** Luna acquisition agent and coordinator, 2026-07-14; manually transcribed from the journal PDF native text layer and visually checked against p. 3; OCR uncertainty: none.
- **Source relation:** extracted scholarly synthesis.
- **Evidential action:** contextualises.
- **Argument function:** Jungian quaternity context.
- **Consumers:** [[33-s4-p2-complexio-quaternity-senarius]]; [[section-rooms/arguments/A16-Arche-Topos-as-Differential-Field|Arche-Topos as Differential Field]]; movement 33 differentiated-wholeness vocabulary.
- **Use boundary:** establishes Courtney’s cited scholarly synthesis; do not quote its embedded Jacobi, Jung, or Edinger fragments as if independently verified from those editions.

<a id="courtney-2019-salt-point-kairos-chaos-q002"></a>
## Passage card — `courtney-2019-salt-point-kairos-chaos-q002` — Cross-register non-reduction
^courtney-2019-salt-point-kairos-chaos-q002

> “Including observations of discrete time crystals in a depth-psychological essay does not reduce the salt-point and its meaning to a physical mechanism.”

- **Locator:** PDF p. 7/12, “Kairos and Discrete Time Crystals,” immediately before the Jung psychoid/neutral-background discussion.
- **Status:** quotation-ready.
- **Verification:** Luna acquisition agent and coordinator, 2026-07-14; manually transcribed from the journal PDF native text layer and visually checked against p. 7; OCR uncertainty: none.
- **Source relation:** extracted scholarly synthesis.
- **Evidential action:** qualifies.
- **Argument function:** cross-register limitation.
- **Consumers:** [[33-s4-p2-complexio-quaternity-senarius]]; [[section-rooms/arguments/A16-Arche-Topos-as-Differential-Field|Arche-Topos as Differential Field]]; movement 33 anti-reduction boundary.
- **Use boundary:** blocks a physical mechanism from doing the work of symbolic meaning; it does not prove the QL 4+2 derivation or sacred/numerological causality.
